meta.title: Yusuf Wandana | Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Software engineer from Indonesia with over five years building rule-heavy enterprise systems across backend and frontend. NestJS, Laravel, Next.js, and the services behind them.

hero.pitch: Over five years building web applications across backend and frontend, mostly rule-heavy enterprise systems: multi-layer approval engines, field-level access control, multi-party onboarding, and financial calculations.

capabilities.title: Three things I get asked for most

backend.title: Building systems that are clean and maintainable
backend.body: I have experience building systems from monoliths to microservices, both from scratch and taking over existing systems. I usually determine the service boundaries so that each part can be worked on without interfering with the others.

product.title: Frequently changing business rules
product.body: I am accustomed to handling complex and dynamic business workflow requirements. Therefore, I build systems that are easily modifiable without having to rebuild them from scratch.

systems.title: From requirement analysis to release
systems.body: I am always involved in requirement discussions with clients, system and database design as well. If needed, I can also handle the frontend and testing side of things.

stack.title: What I reach for
stack.lead: The things I actually reach for, not everything I have ever touched.

notes.frontend: The part that users see and interact with
notes.backend: The part that runs the business logic and stores the data
notes.tools: The part that makes the work easier, faster, and more reliable
notes.soft: The part that makes the work more effective, and the team more productive

experience.title: Where I have worked and what I have done

points: Co-leader and technical advisor on the enterprise CRM and insurance projects, helping shape system design and database schema, and reviewing code from team members.
Own backend modules end to end across monolith and microservices architectures, from data modeling and API contracts through production go-live and post-launch maintenance.
Contribute to frontend work when needed, taking features from the backend through to the user interface.
Take part in testing modules built by the team before release, making sure business flows and edge cases behave as required.
Authored technical documentation and go-live deliverables: technical specifications, readiness reports, rollback guidelines and data migration reports.
Placed on site at a client to design and build enterprise approval workflows on Nintex K2 and Microsoft SQL Server, from requirements analysis and system design through implementation.
Served as co-leader and technical advisor, giving input on system design and database structure when needed.
Led the high-complexity modules and worked directly with business stakeholders to translate approval policies into configurable routing rules.

Led teams of 2 to 4 engineers on client projects: e-commerce platforms, an agricultural trade marketplace, an accounting system, a production management system, and a property management platform for a housing developer, taking on team leadership early in my career.
Built and maintained web applications and APIs for web and mobile platforms with Laravel and Livewire.
Integrated third-party services, including courier APIs, payment gateways, and a PPOB provider for bill payments and top-ups.
Acted as technical consultant directly to clients, from requirement analysis and on-site presentations through post-deployment maintenance, and managed scope changes as requirements shifted.
Designed and developed ETL workflows in Microsoft SSIS, processing financial data from banks and finance companies for regulatory reporting.
Developed reporting applications for the monthly financial reports at Bank Fama International and Bank Woori Saudara.
Maintained and enhanced the existing SLIK reporting application: bug fixes, feature additions and performance improvements.

jadipintar.title: jadipintar
jadipintar.description: An interactive quiz app with questions across categories. Pick a category, answer one by one, and see your final score. Built with Next.js and Tailwind on static JSON, with a Go backend in progress for dynamic data.

miniStore.title: Mini Store
miniStore.description: A simple online store built during a hands-on course in 2021. Role-based access for admins and customers, product management, order processing, and Midtrans payments, where I got comfortable with Laravel and third-party integration.

enterpriseCrm.title: Enterprise CRM
enterpriseCrm.description: An enterprise CRM for CTI Group, where I own the KYC/KYS onboarding module with a configurable approval engine by entity and region, built the sales pipeline service with multi-year revenue recognition and forecasting, and designed the RBAC system enforced down to the field level. Sole engineer maintaining it in production since go-live.

tces.title: Digital Insurance Platform
tces.description: A digital insurance platform for Tugu Insurance. I built and documented the claims processing system end to end across 10 product lines, each with its own business rules, and designed the service boundaries and data models for authentication, ordering, payments and claims.

eigerEcm.title: Enterprise Content Management
eigerEcm.description: An ECM for Eigerindo MPI built on Nintex K2. I designed the multi-layer dynamic approval engine adopted across every module, routing by transaction value and module-specific rules, and led the Payment Request and Audit Request modules from system design through implementation.
